name: 72. Reasoning Summary Streaming Event Fields (reasoning-summary-fields)
description:
The Responses streaming reasoning_summary_* events went out without fields the OpenAI
Responses streaming spec marks required and non-nullable, and the reasoning item they
describe went out empty. Reported against Gemini on Vertex: a strict client crashed
mid-reply with "undefined is not an object (evaluating 'a.text')" and the session died.

Per openai/openai-openapi, all four events require type, item_id, output_index,
summary_index and sequence_number; text.done also requires text, and part.added/done also
require part ({type: "summary_text", text}). ReasoningItem requires [id, summary, type].

What each case pins:
  1-2  the four events carry summary_index, text and part (Gemini, and Vertex, which
       reaches the same converter through HandleGeminiResponsesStream)
  3    the reasoning item carries the summary its events described, all the way into
       response.completed - previously the thought text never reached the terminal event
  4    the same summary_index fix on Anthropic
  5    Bedrock emitted a hardcoded empty text on reasoning_summary_text.done, dropping the
       whole summary; the done text must equal the deltas that preceded it
  6-7  the Bedrock reasoning item carries summary AND encrypted_content, and replays
       without a 400. These two are one test split in half: populating the summary without
       the signature that signs it sends an unsigned reasoning block, which upstream refuses
  8    Gemini 3 thought signatures survive the streaming path (they were dropped entirely,
       while the non-streaming converter kept them). Gemini 3 usually returns a
       signature-only thought part, which becomes a reasoning item carrying
       encrypted_content and no summary events - so the case accepts either route.
  9-10 the reverse /genai egress reunites a signature with its text on one part, and no
       longer drops a signature-only reasoning delta (which is how Anthropic and Bedrock
       send theirs)

item.name: gemini/gemini-3.7-flash /genai streaming: thought text and thoughtSignature travel on one part - reasoning-summary-fields

exec: // Gemini-origin: Gemini 3 mints a thoughtSignature on every thinking turn, so one must arrive.
pm.test('gemini-3: a signed part always carries its text data field', function () {
pm.expect(signed, 'no part carried a thoughtSignature, so the signature was dropped on the /genai egress').to.not.be.empty;
pm.expect(p, 'a thoughtSignature part omitted the text data field, which strict adapters reject').to.have.property('text');
pm.test('gemini-3: a signed thought part keeps its text on the same part', function () {
var signedThoughts = parts.filter(function (p) { return p.thought === true && p.thoughtSignature; });
var withText = signedThoughts.filter(function (p) { return typeof p.text === 'string' && p.text.length > 0; });
pm.expect(withText, 'every signed thought part came through with empty text, so the signature was split away from the thought it signs').to.not.be.empty;
